name: Grandma Johnson's Fried Rice
author: Grandma Johnson
steps: This may be used with cooked turkey, ham, pork, or shrimp.
Brown meat in a little oil along with the chopped onion (1/2 cup) and chopped green peppers.
Prepare separately 2 - 3 cups of rice - set aside.
Beat 1 or 2 eggs and fry separately. Chop up and add to meat and onion mixture. Then add the rice and mix together in a large skillet or wok.
Mix soy sauce and water with 1 to 2 T of sugar. Pour over rice mixture and cook another 3 to 5 minutes before serving.
